mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals stronger household demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending drives corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth above trend does not precede SPX gains in > 70% of cases, or if the correlation between GDPC1 growth and SPX returns weakens (Pearson r < 0.3) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing output, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as supply chain disruptions and inventory overhangs depress corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines do not precede SPX declines in > 60% of cases, or if the correlation between INDPRO declines and SPX returns weakens (Pearson r > -0.2) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above its 12-month moving average signals labor market weakness, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher unemployment reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases do not precede SPX declines in > 60% of cases, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns weakens (Pearson r > -0.3) over any 3-year rolling window.

failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases do not precede SPX declines in > 60% of cases, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns weakens (Pearson r > -0.3) over any 3-year rolling window.
